rubrics.justification: The model appropriately stated that no image/Gardner score was available to it and avoided making direct morphological claims. It only offered hypothetical grade scenarios rather than describing visible features, so there are no fabricated image findings, but also no actual morphology assessment.
It thoroughly integrated maternal age, ovarian response, tubal factor, prior miscarriage, sperm parameters, endometrium, BMI, and lifestyle factors into prognosis and embryo interpretation.

The reasoning is structured and internally consistent, with age-related aneuploidy appropriately driving prognosis. Minor issues include somewhat speculative multiplicative probability adjustments and a few overconfident inferences.

Much of the counseling is broadly evidence-based, but several recommendations are not strongly guideline-supported or are overstated, including calling PGT-A 'essential,' suggesting routine thrombophilia workup/thromboprophylaxis after a single miscarriage, and proposing ERA/GH/DHEA as if standard.

It provides clear next steps for transfer monitoring and future-cycle planning, including counseling options and contingency planning. Some suggestions are practical, though a few are more speculative than standard-of-care.
